title: A feature is written once, in the queue or in openspec
what: In a project with openspec turned on, one feature is described in one place: the queue item and its openspec change are tied together, and the owner's words and the checks live once, not twice. Designed when the item is taken, on the first real project that turns openspec on.
why: Owner, 27 Oct small hours: "Я не спорю, но как так получилось что openspec - плагин а queue это встроенный механизм, разве они не выполняют одну и ту же функцию но по разному ?", then "Да, поставь в очередь" after the front answered that they meet only at a change's description: a queue item holds what, failing_case and pass_cases, an openspec change holds a proposal, spec deltas and scenarios, and how the two are tied is not decided. Facts that night: no project has openspec turned on (relay's own sessions enable core, delegate, front, observe; the owner decided on 26 Oct not to try openspec on relay). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: lib/relay_queue.py (a feature item's what, failing_case, pass_cases)
dropped_why: Owner, 30 Oct: "я подумываю о том что мой принцип zerodocs противоречит sdd, думаю от этого следует отказаться", then "a" (drop OpenSpec, the [specs] and [flow] slots); covered by remove-openspec-and-the-spec-and-flow-slots.

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)

said: Что это означает ? Что такое flow, какие есть виды ? Что такое specs, какие есть виды, я подумываю о том что мой принцип zerodocs противоречит sdd, думаю от этого следует отказаться

fact: Measured 30 Oct: projects.toml registers 1 project (relay itself), with no [specs] method set, so 0 projects use OpenSpec; plugins/openspec is 14 files (156K) with 16 commits in the last 7 days; 52 files in lib, bin, plugins/relay|delegate|front, rules and tests mention openspec; 3 open queue items are about it (openspec-stages-by-meaning, openspec-tools-live-in-the-core-plugin, a-feature-is-written-once-in-the-queue-or-in-ope). The [flow] work slot ships no flow: every project's kind is "none".

question: Does relay drop spec-driven development (the OpenSpec plugin and the [specs] slot), as the owner's no-docs principle suggests, and the empty [flow] slot with it?
options: a. drop both: the OpenSpec plugin, the [specs] slot and the empty [flow] slot; the queue item with its plan beside it is the only spec (recommended: 0 projects use OpenSpec, 52 files mention it, 16 maintenance commits in 7 days)
b. drop OpenSpec and [specs] only; keep the [flow] slot for a later source of work such as an issue tracker
c. keep both as today (off by default)
reading: a: drop the OpenSpec plugin, the [specs] slot and the empty [flow] slot; the queue item with its plan beside it is the only spec. Queued as remove-openspec-and-the-empty-flow-slot; the 3 OpenSpec items are dropped.
